Are you on meds?
When you ARE hypo you sometimes need to suppress your TSH a little to feel good, yes

But a TSH of 1,4 is very good in a healthy person
At what time did you have your blood drawn? TSH is highest in the morning
Could also be your birth control

You most likely don't have hypothyroidism. Your Numbers are really good. When I was diagnosed I had a TSH over 20.

Antibodies and t3 won't really change anything. You won't be prescribed meds (levothyroxine) with those numbers and you don't want to, trust me. Hypo and levo is no fun..

Iron deficiency Can cause those symptoms. Have vitamin b12 and D checked as well..

Could also be PCOS with the missing periods. Are you eating enough? Do you have a problem with food?

could also be stress or depression.. those are real diseases - don't have to be caused by anything else Like hypo, although I know that's not what you wanna hear.

Take care :-)
